tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
优化笔记组织功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags to store note details.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and future enhancements.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes using a backend framework like Django or Express.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive frontend page using a framework like React or Vue to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless interaction with the API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature using full-text search or keyword matching in the database or via a search engine like Elasticsearch.
T4.notes: Optimize for performance with large datasets.

T5.implementation_approach: Introduce features like categorization, tagging, and drag-and-drop functionality for better note organization.
T5.notes: Ensure the UI remains intuitive and supports efficient organization.
